name: Osage River — Kings Bluff Access to Bonnots Mill Access
gaugeName: Osage River below St. Thomas, MO (USGS 06926510)
blurb: Osage River in Missouri: sections between public Missouri Department of Conservation accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Kings Bluff Access: exact agency access pin. Take-out Osage-Tavern Access: exact agency access pin. Missouri law: no glass beverage containers on canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in a sealed non-glass cooler; carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat; children under 7 wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry (no agency mileage found).
